name: Are my files uploaded when splitting a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree splits PDFs entirely in your browser. Files never leave your device.

name: Can I split only specific pages from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can extract a custom page range (e.g. pages 3–7) or split every page into individual files.

name: Is there a page limit for splitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no page or file size limits. Processing depends on your device's memory.

name: Can I split a PDF offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is a PWA and works fully offline once loaded in your browser.
